feature_descriptions.url_length: Total number of characters in the URL.
feature_descriptions.hostname_length: Number of characters in the hostname.
feature_descriptions.path_length: Number of characters in the URL path.
feature_descriptions.num_dots: Count of '.' characters (more dots often means more subdomains).
feature_descriptions.num_hyphens: Count of '-' characters in the URL.
feature_descriptions.num_at: Count of '@' characters (an '@' can hide the real destination).
feature_descriptions.num_percent: Count of '%' characters (percent-encoding can obscure content).
feature_descriptions.num_digits: Count of digit characters in the URL.
feature_descriptions.num_subdomains: Number of subdomain labels in the hostname.
feature_descriptions.has_ip: 1 if the host is a raw IP address instead of a domain name.
feature_descriptions.is_https: 1 if the URL uses the https scheme.
feature_descriptions.has_http_token: 1 if 'http' appears again after the scheme (a spoofing trick).
feature_descriptions.has_prefix_suffix: 1 if the domain contains a '-' (brand look-alike trick).
feature_descriptions.has_shortener: 1 if a URL-shortening service is used.
feature_descriptions.has_redirection: 1 if '//' appears inside the path (open-redirect pattern).
feature_descriptions.has_suspicious_word: 1 if the URL contains a known phishing keyword.
feature_descriptions.digit_ratio: Fraction of the URL made up of digits.
